changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.23

- Swap profiles now have a Swap mode toggle (Updated / Legacy). Updated is the current behavior (waits for the inventory to render, Pause Delay, loadouts key pressed 5x). Legacy restores the older open/navigate timing (fixed 550ms inventory wait, loadouts key pressed 2x), which some setups prefer.
- The click cycle, ending loadout, untick delay, all toggles, and all 20 loadouts are identical in both modes; only the open/navigate timing differs. Set per profile; defaults to Updated.
- No changes to packet logic, keybinds, or the update process.
